title: Towards Fast Automatic Design of Silicon Dangling Bond Logic
problem: Automating design of Silicon Dangling Bond (SiDB) logic implementations is inefficient due to massive search space exploration. SiDB logic realizes functions through quantum dot arrangements but determining optimal arrangements computationally expensive.
motivation: SiDB logic promising beyond-CMOS technology but design automation bottleneck prevents practical adoption; reducing automation runtime critical.
method: Dedicated search space pruning strategies systematically eliminate infeasible design regions during automatic SiDB arrangement generation.
key_novelty: Search space pruning techniques achieving 33x speedup in SiDB logic design automation.
contributions: Comprehensive search space pruning strategies for SiDB design
Drastic search space reduction enabling scalable synthesis
limitations: Scope limited to logic circuit complexity not specified; applicability to large designs unclear.
